## 2024-06-12 - XXE Vulnerability in Test Parser
**Vulnerability:** Used `xml.etree.ElementTree` in `swarm/runtime/test_parser.py` which is susceptible to XML External Entity (XXE) and Billion Laughs attacks when parsing externally supplied XML files (e.g., test reports from CI).
**Learning:** Python's standard `xml.etree.ElementTree` is inherently insecure for untrusted data. Test reports generated by external runners must be treated as untrusted input.
**Prevention:** Always use `defusedxml.ElementTree` as a drop-in replacement when parsing XML to secure against these attacks.
